expected_results: The four CLI entry points are exercised end-to-end with a file handoff to the pinned producer signer contract and back (a disposable pure-python RFC-8032 test signer over the REAL signing_material_v3), an ISOLATED test trust store, and a LOCAL mount substitute: build emits request.fields.json (the exact eight producer sign-release fields) and keeps the candidate UNSEALED; assemble verifies the returned release.signature.json against the exact candidate manifest + pinned store (operational, ed25519-v1, synthetic=false) and seals (manifest.sig.json then READY last); publish verifies destination identity/scope, refuses overwrite, and writes READY last after every destination hash verifies; validate (standalone, read-only) accepts with the operational signature, all nine evidence references and every file hash.

Failure checks all REJECT with value-blind reasons: wrong key (committed store -> unknown_signing_key), expired window (key_not_valid_at_created_at), tampered signature (signature_invalid), mismatched manifest (request_manifest_mismatch), altered candidate files (altered_files), already-sealed / existing release (already_sealed / release_exists), unverifiable mount (mount_identity_unverifiable), interrupted publication (published_file_hash_mismatch -> no READY -> consumer missing_ready), tampered published file (file_hash_mismatch), missing READY (missing_ready); the consumer run is write-free (read-only tree unchanged byte-for-byte).

No real operational key, NAS, network, MT5, broker or credential; the committed operational trust store and the frozen v0.2/v0.3 contracts are unchanged; secret scan no findings; evidence linter PASS; make governance-check green.

Live staging inventory documented (producer signer files, imports, artefact hashes, interpreter, paths, ACLs, CLI argument order) with the custodian handoff and the Mac mini acceptance; CI evidence kept distinct from live NAS acceptance.
